verdict.rationale: PostHog's own docs refer to capturing events from 'any SDK'. The AI wizard 'writes code and instruments the PostHog SDKs client-side and server-side' across 26+ documented frameworks and languages. A community user reports straightforward integration in a Swift iOS app, and Endpoints publish OpenAPI 3.0 specs for generating typed clients. missing for 10: a first-party SDK catalog or reference docs listing supported languages, versioning and API surface (SDK coverage is mostly implied through the wizard and event docs); the MCP Analytics SDK is still 0.x beta.
